$comment: BFP-3301 boiler feed pump twin. Expected values in Maximo Monitor from the pump curves, the affinity laws, the ISO 5198 thermodynamic method and the plant design; the device sends only what it measures.

identification.model: CHTR barrel pull-out pump (API 610 type BB5), size and stages as an assumed selection
identification.description: Boiler feed pump A (2 x 50 %) of a steam power unit, VSD motor drive, balance drum leak-off and minimum-flow valve
identification.pump: KSB CHTR, multistage barrel type, double-suction first stage, balance drum, 6 stages (assumed selection)
identification.drive: Medium-voltage induction motor on a variable speed drive, step-up gearbox to pump speed
identification.minflow: Automatic recirculation (minimum-flow) control valve on the discharge, back to the deaerator
identification.balance: Balance drum leak-off line back to the deaerator with its own flow meter
identification.bearings: Two journal bearings and a tilting-pad thrust bearing, forced-oil lubrication

pump.source: KSB CHTR barrel pull-out pump: leaflet 2701.022/01-EN (11.25) and product page https://www.ksb.com/en-ro/lc/C38A (API 610 / ISO 13709 type BB5, balance drum, flow <= 1450 m3/h, head <= 4000 m, <= 400 bar, 7000 rpm). The duty point inside that envelope is an assumption: typical value, replace with the certified test curve of your pump: BEP 520 m3/h and 2,050 m at 5,300 rpm, 81 % efficiency, shut-off head 2,520 m (1.23 x BEP head), head curve H = H0 + h2 Q^2 through those two points, efficiency curve eta_BEP x (2x - x^2) with x = Q / Q_BEP, NPSH3 = 14 m x (0.5 + 0.5 x^2) at BEP speed (double-suction first stage), minimum continuous flow 35 % of the BEP flow at the same speed.

balance.source: assumption: typical value, replace with the pump vendor's balance drum leak-off figure at the rated differential pressure (here about 3 % of the BEP flow). Leak-off through the drum clearance grows with the square root of the pressure across it.

drive.source: assumption: typical value, replace with the motor and gearbox data sheets (motor 97 % x gearbox 98.5 %), measured as VSD output power.

water.source: ISO 5198:1987, clause 11 and tables 15 (isothermal factor a), 16 (density) and 17 (cp), column 100 bar: rho 913.0 kg/m3 at 160 degC (903.2 at 170), a 0.6286 / 0.5973 / 0.5630 x 1e-3 m3/kg at 150 / 160 / 170 degC, cp 4277.8 / 4303.7 / 4332.6 J/(kg K): straight lines through them. Vapour pressure: Antoine equation for water, 99 to 374 degC, log10(p mmHg) = 8.14019 - 1810.94 / (244.485 + T degC).

suction.source: assumption: typical value, replace with the plant layout (deaerator storage tank floor 25 m above the pump suction), the deaerator normal level and operating pressure (5.12 bar g, saturated at 160 degC), the suction pipe loss at the BEP flow and the clean strainer pressure drop.

system.source: assumption: typical value, replace with the feedwater system: head the pump must give to put the rated 500 m3/h per pump into the boiler drum (static part: drum pressure and elevation), a 300 MW unit, this pump carrying half the feed.

bearings.source: assumption: typical value, replace with the commissioning values of your pump: bearing temperature rise above the oil supply at rated speed (scaled with speed squared) and the bearing housing vibration.

demo.note: Demo only: the plant runs in real time; faults ramp in over a minute or so.

points.label: VSD output power to the motor
Flow into the pump (suction flow meter)
Recirculation flow back to the deaerator

limits.source: assumption: typical value, replace with your own operating practice and the vendor's limits. Head and efficiency 5 % / 10 % below the curve, leak-off 1.5 x / 2 x the expected value, NPSH margin ratio 1.5 / 1.2, strainer 0.5 bar, flow meter and thermodynamic flow 8 % apart, bearing 10 K above the commissioning rise, vibration 4.5 / 7.1 mm/s (check the ISO 10816-7 zone limits for your pump category and power).

failure_modes.$comment: Each failure mode: what degrades, how it shows, the rules that see it.

impeller_wear.name: Impeller and wear-ring wear (internal recirculation)
impeller_wear.symptoms: head and thermodynamic efficiency down at the same flow and speed, VSD speed up to keep the feed flow

balance_drum_wear.name: Balance drum clearance wear
balance_drum_wear.symptoms: leak-off flow up against the expected value, thrust bearing hotter, efficiency slightly down

minflow_valve_stuck.name: Minimum-flow valve fails to open at low load
minflow_valve_stuck.symptoms: unit load falls, valve stays shut, flow through the pump below its minimum (demo lowers the load)

recirc_valve_passing.name: Minimum-flow valve passing (seat leak)
recirc_valve_passing.symptoms: recirculation flow with the valve shut, more speed and power for the same feed

npsh_loss.name: NPSH loss: deaerator pressure decay and low level (cavitation)
npsh_loss.symptoms: deaerator pressure falls faster than the suction water cools, level low, NPSH margin gone, vibration up

strainer_clogging.name: Suction strainer clogging
strainer_clogging.symptoms: strainer differential pressure up, suction pressure and NPSH margin down

bearing_degradation.name: Journal bearing degradation
bearing_degradation.symptoms: journal bearing temperature above its normal rise, vibration up

flow_meter_drift.name: Suction flow transmitter drift
flow_meter_drift.symptoms: metered flow disagrees with the flow from shaft power and thermodynamic efficiency
